## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change does for the user.
Link the related issue, if any.

## Verification

List the commands, platform and results. Distinguish focused checks from the full
suite and note known failures. For visible UI changes, include phone and wide
screenshots with fictional or redacted data. GitHub Actions are disabled.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe any stored-data, permission, native-protocol or deployment changes.
Link updated guides where behavior changed. Source completion does not mean a
running installation was upgraded. Remove sections that do not apply.
